then.prompt: Remove a steam counter from Backup Protocol: BLU? (If not, it is destroyed.)

_comment: Three clauses plus the Crank keyword. Crank itself is engine-side from the card DB keywords field (ability_keywords.crank) - deliberately not authored. (1) 'Enters the arena with a steam counter': TRIGGERED ON_ENTER_PLAY + PUT_COUNTER, the shipped arc/teklo_core_blue.json pattern. (2) Upkeep: CONDITIONAL wraps MAY so both edges are right - with a steam counter the MAY offers remove-or-destroy (declining runs MAY's else = DESTROY_SELF); with zero counters (stripped by another effect) the CONDITIONAL else destroys it since removal is impossible. The gate sits on CONDITIONAL's 'when', NOT ability-level conditions (checked at resolution; would skip the destroy too) and NOT on the MAY (loader pops those into an effect-level gate, skipping the destroy). Same shape as the sibling draft .drafts/assembly_module_blue.json. START_OF_TURN reaches only the turn player's permanents, which is exactly 'your turn'. (3) Instant: card-level activation_cost 2 carries the {r}{r} (a PAY_RESOURCES cost would double-charge); DESTROY_SELF is the ability cost. The retrieval is BANISH(from_zone GRAVEYARD, color/class_filter/subtype) + MOVE_REF(hand) rather than SEARCH_GRAVEYARD because SEARCH_GRAVEYARD reads only type/subtype/slug/name filters - it has NO colour or class filter, so it could not express 'blue Mechanologist'. _hand_card_filter (which BANISH's graveyard branch uses) ANDs colour + type/subtype + class, so all three printed restrictions hold. MODELLING ARTIFACT: the card transits the banished zone for an instant before MOVE_REF puts it in hand - net zones match the printed text (graveyard -> hand) but any respond-to-banish triggers on the retrieved card would fire spuriously; same accepted artifact as .drafts/avalon_archangel_of_rebirth.json. No matching card in the graveyard: BANISH pool empty, ref unset, MOVE_REF no-ops (fail to find).
